See today\'s steps and calories burned here, and your heart rate during workouts and walk/run tracking, read from Health Connect. You choose which of these to share, and what LogEZ reads stays on this device.

LogEZ uses your precise location to record this walk/run\'s distance, pace and route, including while the screen is off, until you tap Finish or Cancel. The route is saved only on this phone. The map loads map images for the area on screen from OpenFreeMap, which lets it see roughly where you are.
Location permission is needed to track a run or walk.

Stops reading Health Connect and deletes the readings LogEZ saved

LogEZ will stop reading Health Connect and delete the daily steps, calories burned and workout heart-rate readings it saved on this device.\n\nYour workouts, routes and measurements stay. The data in Health Connect itself is not touched. You can connect again from the Profile tab.
Health Connect disconnected and its readings deleted
Couldn\'t delete the Health Connect readings. Nothing was changed.
Erases every workout, routine, measurement, photo and setting

This permanently erases everything in LogEZ: workouts, routes, routines, custom exercises, measurements, progress photos, goals, saved Health Connect readings and your settings. The exercise library is restored to its original state.\n\nFiles you already exported or saved to Pictures are not affected. Make a full backup first if you might want this data back.
Couldn\'t delete your data. Nothing was changed.
Finish or discard your current workout before deleting all data.

Exported files are plain and unencrypted — anything that can open them can read them, including any app you share them with. Keep them somewhere you trust. LogEZ never uploads them; the only thing this app sends over the internet is map tiles, and only while a GPS route is on screen.
Report a problem or suggest an idea by email
Libraries, fonts and map data LogEZ is built with

LogEZ is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition. Heart-rate zones, calories and other figures are general fitness estimates. Talk to a healthcare professional before starting a new exercise programme.
LogEZ is built with the open-source software, fonts and map data below. Tap an entry to read its licence. Maps: OpenFreeMap © OpenMapTiles © OpenStreetMap contributors (openstreetmap.org/copyright).
